bibliographic.title: Medical Hallucinations in Foundation Models and Their Impact on Healthcare

relevance_to_mlgg: Large-scale evaluation of 11 foundation models across 7 medical tasks. Key finding: general-purpose models hallucinate LESS than medical-specialized models. Chain-of-thought reduces hallucination significantly. Directly informs MLGG provider selection.
key_findings: Chain-of-thought reduced hallucination in 86.4% of comparisons
84.7% of clinicians consider hallucinations capable of causing patient harm
actionable_for_mlgg: Prefer general-purpose models (Claude, GPT-4o) over medical-specialized for extraction
Enable chain-of-thought / adaptive thinking (already using adaptive thinking for Claude)
Quantify hallucination-free rate for MLGG extraction as quality metric
Provider comparison: Claude vs DeepSeek accuracy benchmarking needed
